Fabric API followed (0.158.0+26.2, fabric-data-generation-api-v1 25.5.0): FabricTagsProvider.FabricIntrinsicHolderTagsProvider (valueLookupBuilder) is gone, FabricTagAppender<E, T> became FabricTagAppender<T> (remove(ResourceKey)), builder answers 26.2's TagAppender. The 26.1.2 types come back as the layer's facades (classRenames; facade/TagAppender carries 26.1.2's bodies and Fabric API 24.3.4's TagAppenderMixin bodies). The members that answered them are restored on 26.2's classes with 26.1.2's bodies: TagsProvider.tag(TagKey) / tag(TagKey, boolean) (CbS26TagsProviderRestoredMixin), FabricTagsProvider.builder / valueLookupBuilder (CbS26FapiTagsProviderRestoredMixin); the element-to-key conversion of the providers 26.1.2 derived from the deleted classes is CbS26TagsProviderKeyedMixin's. Climbed layer facades extending IntrinsicHolderTagsProvider (1.21.6 ItemTagsProvider, 1.21.4 WinterDrop*TagsProvider, 1.21 class_8907 / class_8997) extend the facade, and the 1.21.6 layer's CbIntrinsicTagsRestoredMixin is retargeted onto it with the rename (MixinClassRenames: a mixin aimed at a facade keeps every rename).
